jobs.title: Soc Analyst (Remote)
jobs.description: As a CyOps SOC Analyst, you will investigate security alerts generated by the Cynet platform, detect threats, and support live incident response engagements. You will analyze suspicious programs and software, classify malware based on observed behaviors and known threats, and contribute threat intelligence and malware analysis reports. We truly appreciate your interest in joining our team. To help
